title: Alternating Three Ribbon And Block Chain
description: One newly authored complete fixed ribbon-linked wooden-block toy appearance laid out as one straight connected chain. Six whole thick chamfered timber tiles have genuine narrow gaps. Three separate continuous finite-thickness ribbons run along the entire chain: a centre ribbon alternates over and under successive whole tiles, while the two outer ribbons take the opposite alternating route. Each ribbon passes diagonally through the intervening gaps and remains one connected closed solid, not disconnected painted stripes. The lower ribbon spans have finite flat grounding faces. This complete serial alternating face-wrapping topology is not an enlarged crossed-bow gift parcel or additional castanet shells on one neck cord; all tile and band coordinates are newly authored without imported old meshes. One model zero scenes, three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal envelope centred. A generic Jacob-ladder-inspired fixed illustrative exterior only, not a demonstrated working toy mechanism or a fabrication guide. The straight laid-out pose does not prove alternating flip kinematics, joint travel, slack, ribbon flexibility, fastening, durability, child suitability, choking safety, manufacture or play function. No hands, packaging, motion, rigging or animation.
